hook: Enzymes designed from scratch attach ubiquitin to one chosen lysine among 45 on the protein PCNA
hook_turn: attach ubiquitin to one chosen lysine among 45 on the protein PCNA
summary: Using RFdiffusion3, the authors designed ligases that tag a chosen lysine with ubiquitin; 35 of 48 designs worked on a model peptide. One design hit K164 of PCNA and, with a single mutation, built chains of defined length, outperforming a natural E2. It is a test-tube result on one target protein, not shown in living cells.
title: De novo design of ligases for programmable site-specific protein ubiquitylation
